title: Emergency-lighting changeover unit
goal: A reader must be able to see how mains charges a battery and holds a relay that changes the emergency lamp supply on mains failure.

rubric.must: The 230 V MAINS INPUT feeds a labelled battery charger whose battery terminals connect to a 12 V, 7 Ah sealed battery.
The K1 MAINS-SENSE COIL is visibly connected across LINE and NEUT.
The K1 CHANGEOVER RELAY visibly has LINE on its NO side, BATT on its NC side, and LAMP on its common output.
The emergency lamp is connected from the relay’s LAMP output to the return.
A normally open S1 LAMP TEST switch visibly connects the battery to a separate test indicator lamp.
The charger, battery, relay, and lamp have legible voltage or power ratings.
